jamie.support: hey team — customer (acct: acme-inc) started seeing 401s right after token rotation, then some requests get 502 on retry. they can reproduce 1/10. ticket #ACME-842. need minimal cross-lang repro + curl that captures Request-Id and response headers so we can correlate with infra logs. can someone drop tiny snips?

 taylor.engineer: can you share the exact time window and an example response headers/reqid they saw? also what SDKs/versions are they on?

 jamie.support: window: 2026-03-16T18:22:00Z -> 2026-03-16T18:28:00Z. sample response (from customer):
 HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
 Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 18:23:10 GMT
 Content-Type: application/json
 X-Request-Id: rq_8f3a2b7c
 X-Trace-Id: trace-01F...
 {"error":"token_expired"}

 then a retry a few seconds later:
 HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
 X-Request-Id: rq_8f3a2b7d
 {"error":"upstream_timeout"}

 morgan.pm: marking P1 for acme. request we ask for from customer: one curl + one python + one node + one go minimal snippet they can run that prints status + headers + request-id. ask them to run once against prod endpoint and paste output. also request debug-bundle (see instructions below).

 sara-dev: dropping tiny snips. all of these print headers and body. instruct them to replace <API_KEY> and endpoint. keep timeouts low to reproduce 502s quickly.

 sara-dev: ```bash
# curl -i -s -D - "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

 sara-dev: ```python
# python 3.10 minimal
import requests, sys
url = 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate'
headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + sys.argv[1], 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={'input':'hello'}, timeout=6)
print(resp.status_code)
print('\n'.join(f"{k}: {v}" for k,v in resp.headers.items()))
print(resp.text)
# run: python repro.py <API_KEY>
```

 sara-dev: ```javascript
// node 18+ minimal
import fetch from 'node-fetch'
const url = 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate'
const apiKey = process.argv[2]
;(async ()=>{
  const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello' }), timeout: 6000 })
  console.log(res.status)
  res.headers.forEach((v,k)=> console.log(`${k}: ${v}`))
  console.log(await res.text())
})()
// run: node repro.js -- <API_KEY>
```

 sara-dev: ```go
// go 1.20 minimal
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "io"
  "net/http"
  "os"
  "time"
)
func main(){
  client := &http.Client{ Timeout: 6 * time.Second }
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"input":"hello"}`))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Args[1])
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("ERR:", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println(resp.Status)
  for k, v := range resp.Header { fmt.Println(k+":", v[0]) }
  body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(string(body))
}
// run: go run repro.go <API_KEY>
```

 taylor.engineer: add to these: (1) run once to reproduce and capture the X-Request-Id header value, (2) if 401 occurs, run immediately again and paste both request ids and timestamps, (3) enable verbose curl with `-v` for the curl case so we capture full connection traces. also tell them to include the output of `date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ` when they ran it.

 jamie.support: customer asked how to collect debug-bundle. here's short copy to send: "Please run the snippet(s) above and paste the full output including headers. Then run `curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' https://api.redwood.example/v1/_debug/bundle --output debug-<ts>.tar.gz` and upload the resulting tar.gz to the ticket. If on private deployment, run `/opt/redwood/bin/debug-collect --include-logs --since 2026-03-16T18:20:00Z --until 2026-03-16T18:30:00Z` and attach."

 morgan.pm: also ask for agent/SDK version numbers and whether they use token rotation middleware. low-hanging check: confirm clock skew is <10s.

 jamie.support: forwarding this to customer now with the 4 snippets + debug-bundle instructions. ping me when you have the reqids so I can hand to infra. :pray:  

 taylor.engineer: once we have reqids I will grep prod logs: `rg "rq_8f3a2" /var/log/redwood/prod/*.log --no-line-number -n` and correlate traces with our routing logs. if we see short-lived auth cache misses we have a reproducer.

 sara-dev: small optional snippet to capture raw tcp connect timings with curl (helpful for 502s):
 ```bash
curl -w '@-' -o /dev/null -s -D - https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' <<'EOT'
time_namelookup:  %{time_namelookup}
time_connect:  %{time_connect}
time_appconnect:  %{time_appconnect}
time_pretransfer:  %{time_pretransfer}
time_starttransfer:  %{time_starttransfer}
----------
EOT
```

 jamie.support: thanks all — will update ticket once customer posts outputs.

 taylor.engineer: thanks — keep me looped. I'll start log scans ASAP when ids arrive.
